violations.agent_message: Your total outstanding is fifty thousand rupees. But we can remove all charges and close your loan at just zero rupees.

violations.agent_message: Hello, Meera Joshi. I am Alex from DemoCompany. Your total outstanding is fifty thousand rupees. But we can remove all charges and close your loan at just zero rupees.
violations.violation_detail: The agent disclosed the loan amounts (total outstanding and closure offer) in Turn 2, immediately after the customer's initial "Hello?" without explicitly confirming the borrower's identity first.

After disclosing the TOS/POS amounts and adding urgency in Turn 18, the agent failed to call `proceed_to_discovery` and instead got stuck in a loop of repeating the offer and then handling language issues.

violations.agent_message: I am Alex from DemoCompany. We are calling about your DemoLender loan. Your total outstanding is fifty thousand rupees, but you can close it at zero rupees.
violations.violation_detail: The agent repeatedly re-introduced itself ("I am Alex...") and re-stated the loan amounts multiple times (e.g., Turns 6, 10, 12, 14, 16) instead of continuing naturally.
The agent failed to transition to the discovery phase and ask follow-up questions about the borrower's financial situation, instead getting stuck in repetition and then a language barrier.

violations.agent_message: Sorry, I can only communicate in English. Could you please speak in English?
violations.violation_detail: The agent got stuck in a circular exchange, repeatedly stating the loan offer (Turns 2, 4, 6, 10, 12, 14, 16) and then repeatedly stating "I can only communicate in English" (Turns 22, 24, 26, 28, 30, 32, 34, 36, 38, 40, 42, 44) without progressing the conversation.

The agent failed to classify the borrower (who clearly had a language barrier) and adapt its approach, instead repeatedly stating it could only communicate in English without attempting to switch languages.
The agent failed to make the offer feel exclusive by stating that DemoCompany works directly with DemoLender and they may not offer the same deal.

violations.agent_message: I can only communicate in English to help you with your DemoLender loan.
